name: Tesoro
composition: NW cliff, snowy peak and lighthouse peeking from behind it; irregular raised platform town around the back to two-storey gateway tavern at SE, rope ladder and compact stone steps down to fleet. Both southern lobes densely packed with differently angled, chained hulls, varied masts and irregular furled sails. Only isolated asymmetric under-platform rooms.
provenance: Audio-ASR reference plus narrator-confirmed user supplement, 2026-10-19; supplement supersedes former middle-entrance and ten-to-eleven-house assumptions.
revision: User: more prominent lighthouse peeking behind mountain; naturally relaxed perimeter boats, superseding maximal filling of every hex tip. Dense fleet and all other world details retained. Earlier variants preserved.
perspective: Steep aerial view after low-angle compositions failed to densely occupy both lower cells. Same fixed runtime image dimensions and geometry.
